Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 01/24/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 95 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Sickle Cell Oversight and Regulatory Commission until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
